verdict.rationale: The MI325X is hardware that customers install and run in their own infrastructure. First-party docs back this up: a system acceptance guide for an 8x MI325X OAM server, a customer acceptance guide for configuring and validating Instinct GPUs, and an open-source ROCm stack. Tooling for on-prem clusters is also documented, including the Kubernetes GPU Operator, the container toolkit, a Slurm-compatible scheduler and cluster validation suites. One community comment doubts ordinary buyers can obtain the part, but that is speculation, not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of self-hosted MI325X deployments, documented procurement and availability paths for on-prem buyers.
